label: preparing
what: The baker and builder appear to have jointly prepared a bakery/lighting-related display or setup: builder placed lanterns, then supplied the baker lanterns and oak planks, which the baker stored in a chest. The record does not establish exactly what the intended finished item or project was, nor clearly show the mayor was uninformed; the addendum mentions a hall-lighting inspection approved by the mayor, but whether it is the same undertaking is uncertain.
